title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody — Episode7 A Singing Voice That Rocks The World

meta.Episode: Episode7 — A Singing Voice That Rocks The World
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, I should use this sound here.
There isn't a huge difference, but I feel like it's more reflective of the kindness I'm trying to capture.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That just leaves the key change between the bridge and the last chorus...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, the bridge should be all set now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Come to think of it...
I had to think a lot about what sorts of phrases I wanted to use for the bridge.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I'm glad that I did.
You only get to hear the bridge once, so it has a fairly different kind of presence compared to the chorus, which is played several times.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wrote it with everyone smiling in mind. As brief as this phrase is, I wanted it to become this unforgettable glimmer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's why I won't use any effects.
I want to use just raw sound. Next is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, let's see how this sounds...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
This song... It's even better than I...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But I shouldn't be patting myself on the back just yet. I need to hear how it sounds when Miku sings it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I-If I showed this to Miku, she'd probably...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku needs to listen to this song...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm... I'm playing pretty well today...
It might be nice to jam with someone else...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's wrong? You seem really flustered... You also seem really happy, though...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's because I am...
The truth is, I've been working on my own song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, I worked really hard on it...
And finally, today... I'm finally finished writing it. Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Please, Miku...
I want you to listen to it....!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course.
I'd love to hear your song, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You've created a wonderful song.
It's clear that you put an incredible amount of thought into it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Each note gently showed me just how much you care about the others, how you want to be there for them and cherish their brilliant smiles.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only that, you chose the instruments that Leo/need uses. You must have had the others in mind while writing it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right...
I wrote this hoping that we'd play it as a band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At the moment, only Honami knows that I'm writing a song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But now that you've given me your seal of approval, Miku, I think I can present it to the others as our newest song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This song is going to let me sing with all of you in your world.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Obviously, I'm not the same Miku that's in your world...
However, while listening to this song, I got the feeling that it connects me to all of you girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought really hard, trying a lot of different melodies and having you sing them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At first, I felt so happy just to hear you sing phrases that I'd come up with, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But after a while, I began to feel bad about having you sing all these incomplete melodies.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I was able to approach the sound I was going for with the help of a certain someone. I was able to produce a melody that I feel satisfied with because of them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And...
Miku, when I heard you sing that melody for the first time, I...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought our hearts were in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The way I wanted to show how much I want to be there for everyone and how brilliant their smiles are... Miku, through your singing voice, you said that you understand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That made me so happy.
Which is why when I finished writing my song earlier...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It felt like we made it together...
I didn't create it alone. This song felt like our song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
I have to think that my counterpart also feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, she sounded like she was having so much fun while singing your song, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I also want lots and lots of people in your world to hear the song you and her created, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This song, your thoughts, your feelings, this melody... The people who need it most are going to be so touched by them all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, Ichika...?
Would you mind if I tried singing it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to sing your song, too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, can I... Can I sing with you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you think I was going to say no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wrote this song with Miku, and now we're really singing it together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is the closest I've ever felt to Miku.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Music really is a wonderful thing...
Not only does it have the power to resonate in someone's heart, it has the ability to tie people's hearts together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to keep writing more songs... With Miku.)
